claim: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker returns 33 landmarks.
quote: """The 33 pose landmarks."""

claim: MoveNet returns 17 keypoints.
quote: MoveNet is an ultra fast and accurate model that detects 17 keypoints of a body.

claim: PoseNet and MoveNet return 17 keypoints and BlazePose 33, each with x, y, score and name.
quote: PoseNet and MoveNet both return 17 keypoints. MediaPipe BlazePose returns 33 keypoints. Each keypoint contains x, y, score and name.

claim: BlazePose adds keypoints3D and a segmentation mask.
quote: In addition, MediaPipe BlazePose also returns an array of 3D keypoints and a segmentation mask.

claim: Each MediaPipe landmark carries visibility and presence.
quote: presence: Landmark presence. Should stay unset if not supported.

claim: Each MediaPipe landmark carries visibility.
quote: visibility: Landmark visibility. Should stay unset if not supported.

claim: World landmarks in meters with the origin between the hips.
quote: Real-world 3D coordinates in meters with the origin at the center between hips.

claim: TF.js places BlazePose keypoints3D in a 2 x 2 x 2 meter space.
quote: x, y and z represent absolute distance in meters in a 2 x 2 x 2 meter cubic space.

claim: The hip centre is (0, 0, 0) in BlazePose's keypoints3D.
quote: so the coordinate for the hip center is (0, 0, 0).

claim: The Tasks num_poses option defaults to 1.
quote: num_poses: int = 1

claim: num_poses is the maximum number of poses the PoseLandmarker can detect.
quote: num_poses: The maximum number of poses can be detected by the PoseLandmarker.

claim: MoveNet SinglePose Lightning is the default and fastest single-pose model.
quote: `SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING`. Default. The fastest single-pose detector.

claim: MoveNet SinglePose Thunder is more accurate but slower.
quote: `SINGLEPOSE_THUNDER`. A more accurate but slower single-pose detector.

claim: MoveNet MultiPose Lightning detects up to 6 people.
quote: `MULTIPOSE_LIGHTNING`. Multi-pose detector that detects up to 6 poses.

claim: MultiPose can track people across frames with an ID.
quote: If true, each pose will have an ID that uniquely identifies a person. Only used with multi-pose models.

claim: Lightning takes 192x192 input.
quote: MOVENET_SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING_RESOLUTION = 192

claim: Thunder takes 256x256 input.
quote: MOVENET_SINGLEPOSE_THUNDER_RESOLUTION = 256
